notes.title: Demons Infernalize Update
notes.notes:
The latest updates to Demons Infernalize include the following:

[b] Gamepad Support: [/b]
The game currently supports a gamepad. However, you may have to use a mouse or keyboard in the menus. We were able to do the tests with the xbox controller because that's all we had.

[b] A better character controller: [/b]
In the old version, the player could drift and his movement was very slippery. In the new version you have a stable player.

[b] Designing from scratch: [/b]
Game shaders, lighting and map design have been redesigned from the ground up. We added visual effects from our other game (Rogue Ottoman) and they fit the game design very well. The user interface has been redesigned.

[b] New abilities: [/b]
The old abilities in the game were very broken and didn't work properly. We've replaced them with better and more varied abilities. You can improve each ability in its own way and improve your character so you can survive longer.

[b] New enemy patterns: [/b]
The main enemy patterns are survivors-like. However, we added one or two different enemy types. Nothing too big, but we are sure they will challenge you :D

Play this update of Demons Infernalize to see more new features for yourself and share your feedback with us. GLHF!
